title: Regional Brand Audit Report: Plastic Sachet Polluters in Asia
publisher: Break Free From Plastic Asia Pacific
methodology: Volunteer brand audits conducted from October 2023 to February 2024 in 50 locations across India, Indonesia, the Philippines and Viet Nam. 807 volunteers from 25 organisations collected 33,467 sachets and recorded 2,678 brands.
potential_conflicts: Break Free From Plastic is an advocacy coalition campaigning against plastic pollution and for corporate accountability.
limitations: Citizen-science litter collection, not a representative measurement of all packaging sold, waste generated or pollution attributable to each company. The press release identifies Nestlé among the top ten companies in the audit but does not provide a Nestlé-specific total in the summary.
